display.title: Open Exchange Rates API
display.summary: Query latest, historical, time-series, and OHLC rates, supported currencies, conversions, and plan usage. Supplier terms restrict providing the data through Hub, so callers use their own App ID through the local SDK or CLI.

legal.license: Open Exchange Rates Terms, Acceptable Use Policy, and paid-services agreement; independently authored Pontx metadata and SDK/CLI code

documentation.stabilityNote: The complete boundary is the seven GET endpoints in official v0.7 documentation: latest, historical, currencies, time-series, convert, ohlc, and usage. The supplier's ReadMe machine contract is mutable and has a recorded audit hash; this PontxSpec is an independently curated, one-time imported and reviewed contract.

pricing.summary: Plan tier determines availability of base, time-series, convert, OHLC, and refresh features; refer to supplier pricing and the usage response.

credentials.description: Caller App ID obtained from Open Exchange Rates; read only when the local SDK/CLI executes a direct request.
